summary.zh-CN: Sentry 官方远程 MCP，查询组织与项目、搜索 Issue 与事件、按链接或 ID 读取 Issue 详情。由 Teloa 以 OAuth（动态客户端注册 + PKCE）授权，令牌自动刷新。数据经由 sentry.io 传输。
summary.en: Sentry official remote MCP: find organizations and projects, search issues and events, and read issue details by URL or ID. Authorized by Teloa via OAuth (dynamic client registration + PKCE) with automatic token refresh. Data transits sentry.io.

description.zh-CN: 按链接或 ID 读取 Issue、事件等详情
description.en: Read an issue, event or other resource by URL or ID

conditions.zh-CN: 需在 市场 > 连接 页由本人在浏览器中完成 OAuth 授权；服务器部署需在配置文件设置 oauth.publicCallbackUrl
conditions.en: The owner must complete OAuth authorization in a browser from Market > Connections; server deployments must set oauth.publicCallbackUrl in the config file

conditions.zh-CN: 远程服务的 Bearer 只收 MCP OAuth 令牌，Sentry 用户 Auth Token 须用 Sentry-Bearer 头（Teloa 不支持），故改为 OAuth；服务端支持动态客户端注册与 PKCE S256，本机回环回调（127.0.0.1）尚未实测
conditions.en: The remote server accepts only MCP OAuth tokens as Bearer; Sentry user auth tokens need a Sentry-Bearer header (unsupported in Teloa), so this connector uses OAuth; the server supports dynamic client registration and PKCE S256, and the loopback callback (127.0.0.1) has not been tested yet

conditions.zh-CN: 数据经由 sentry.io 平台传输
